draft.shortGloss: to want; to need; to require
draft.emotion: earnest and focused, expressing a clear personal desire or necessity
notes: Can be followed by either a noun (ต้องการน้ำ, 'need water') or a verb. It is more formal than อยาก (yàak, 'want to'), which is only followed by a verb (or ได้ + noun) in everyday speech.
